analysis.support_validation: Control pipeline reproduced bit-exactly on 5/5 support pairs: pair0 37.75 (CI 10/10), pair1 33.11 (9/10), pair2 35.13 (10/10), pair3 33.99 (10/10), pair4 34.02 (10/10). Simulated mean shift matches target within 0.03 levels on all pairs (+24.88/+24.89, +24.59/+24.59, +24.78/+24.75, +24.81/+24.82, +24.44/+24.45); variance ratio within 1% relative; clipped-255 fraction matches. No alternative candidate improved on any pair.
analysis.rationale: R1 re-ran run_full_analysis on all 5 pairs and re-tested every previously untested axis at the corrected JPEG q8 prefix: DT-predicted motion blur (anisotropy 2.29, pair0 only) 25.92 dB; DT-predicted glass (4/5 pairs, glass_score 1.23-1.46) 30.48 dB; gaussian at fair blur-first order 34.60 dB; gamma_RGB global (ric=-0.376, gamma_suspect) 25.61 dB with shift +15.13 vs target +24.89; post-JPEG brightness order 37.66 dB but clipping 0.3257% vs 0.0052%. R0 control remains best on PSNR and on all second-order statistics (mean shift, variance ratio, clipping, gradient). Noise is excluded: same fixed pipeline reproduces all 5 pairs at 33.1-37.75 dB, while every grid noise function at sev1 adds >=12.75 RMS levels (PSNR ceiling <=29 dB); peeled pair1 'IMPULSE' (extreme_pct 86.8%) is the documented JPEG/blur structural FP (zero_ratio 0.736, var_slope -0.05, spatial_corr 0.92, equal per-channel stds). Residual is JPEG-structured (zero_ratio 0.90, 8x8 block-boundary energy 1.7x interior), consistent with double-JPEG quantization, not a missing step. No candidate met the CHANGE criterion (pair0 >2 dB or >35 dB with supports not worse); R0 pipeline retained.
